{"version": "Notebook/1.0", "items": [{"type": 1, "content": {"json": "# 🌐 Delivery Optimization — Rete
---
Analisi dell'utilizzo di rete: tipo di peer (LAN/Group/Internet), trend nel tempo e contributo della Connected Cache."}, "name": "title"}, {"type": 9, "content": {"version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "parameters": [{"id": "timeRange", "version": "KqlParameterItem/1.0", "name": "TimeRange", "type": 4, "isRequired": true, "value": {"durationMs": 604800000}, "typeSettings": {"selectableValues": [{"durationMs": 3600000}, {"durationMs": 86400000}, {"durationMs": 604800000}, {"durationMs": 2592000000}]}}]}, "name": "parameters"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize LAN=sum(BytesFromLanPeers), Grp=sum(BytesFromGroupPeers),
            Internet=sum(BytesFromIntPeers)
| mv-expand PeerType=pack_array('LAN','Group','Internet') to typeof(string),
            Bytes=pack_array(LAN,Grp,Internet) to typeof(long)
| project PeerType, GB=round(todouble(Bytes)/1073741824.0, 3)", "size": 1, "title": "🥧 Download da peer per tipo di peer", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "piechart"}, "name": "byPeerType"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize Peers=sum(BytesFromPeers), HTTP=sum(BytesFromHttp), CacheServer=sum(BytesFromCacheServer)
| mv-expand Source=pack_array('Peers','HTTP/CDN','Connected Cache') to typeof(string),
            Bytes=pack_array(Peers,HTTP,CacheServer) to typeof(long)
| project Source, GB=round(todouble(Bytes)/1073741824.0, 3)", "size": 1, "title": "🥧 Distribuzione sorgenti download", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "piechart"}, "name": "bySource"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize LAN_MB=sum(BytesFromLanPeers)/1048576.0,
            Group_MB=sum(BytesFromGroupPeers)/1048576.0,
            Internet_MB=sum(BytesFromIntPeers)/1048576.0
         by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc", "size": 0, "title": "📈 Trend download da peer per tipo (MB / giorno)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "barchart"}, "name": "peerTrend"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize Peer_MB=sum(BytesFromPeers)/1048576.0,
            HTTP_MB=sum(BytesFromHttp)/1048576.0,
            Cache_MB=sum(BytesFromCacheServer)/1048576.0
         by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc", "size": 0, "title": "📈 Trend sorgenti (MB / giorno)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "linechart"}, "name": "sourceTrend"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| summarize LanMB=round(sum(BytesFromLanPeers)/1048576.0, 1),
            GroupMB=round(sum(BytesFromGroupPeers)/1048576.0, 1),
            InternetMB=round(sum(BytesFromIntPeers)/1048576.0, 1),
            HttpMB=round(sum(BytesFromHttp)/1048576.0, 1),
            CacheMB=round(sum(BytesFromCacheServer)/1048576.0, 1)
         by DeviceName, Domain
| where LanMB+GroupMB+InternetMB > 0
| order by LanMB desc
| take 50", "size": 0, "title": "🏆 Top 50 device per traffico LAN-peer (ricezione)", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "table", "gridSettings": {"formatters": [{"columnMatch": "LanMB", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "green"}}, {"columnMatch": "HttpMB", "formatter": 8, "formatOptions": {"palette": "red"}}]}}, "name": "topPeerReceivers"}, {"type": 3, "content": {"version": "KqlItem/1.0", "query": "DOStatus_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}

| where BytesFromCacheServer > 0
| summarize Devices=dcount(DeviceName), Jobs=count(),
            CacheGB=round(sum(BytesFromCacheServer)/1073741824.0, 2)
         by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| order by TimeGenerated asc", "size": 0, "title": "🗄️ Connected Cache: contributo giornaliero", "queryType": 0, "resourceType": "microsoft.operationalinsights/workspaces", "visualization": "linechart"}, "name": "mccTrend"}], "isLocked": false}
